policy: Unregistered branches are treated as SPECULATIVE (fail-closed: unknown = untrusted).
Role transitions require an entry in DECISION_LEDGER with actor.
CANDIDATE_RED must never be registered as TRUNK without green evidence bound to the candidate SHA.
Physical deletion is never automatic; DELETE_CANDIDATE requires explicit user ruling.

roles_legend.TRUNK: merged official line (currently stale; master merge deferred)
roles_legend.ACCEPTED_BASE: project-designated accepted base for the current version
roles_legend.ARCHIVE: superseded/merged content; keep for history, no new work
roles_legend.DELETE_CANDIDATE: awaiting explicit user ruling before physical deletion
